messages:
Maria: Heads-up — quarterly access attestation kickoff. The vuln scanner flagged svc-analytics-prod with roles/owner on `projects/redwood-infra`.

Maria: We need evidence of why that service account still has broad privileges, plus a rollback plan if it's in use. tagging @Dave @Alex for context.

Dave: ack. I pulled the alert. svc-analytics-prod was created in 2022 for a one-off migration job. I believe the job migrated in 2023 but the creds were never cleaned up.

Dave: quick check: the SA gets owner via group `infra-ops-admins@redwood.com`.

Alex: Can someone pull audit logs for IAM and KMS activity for the last 90 days? Need to see SetIamPolicy and crypto operations.

Samir: On it. KMS keys of interest live at `projects/redwood-analytics/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/llm-cache-key`. If the SA has decrypt on that key, we need to validate data access scope.

Maria: Reminder: for compliance attestation we either justify the entitlement (business reason + expiry) or remove it. No exceptions without documented approval.

Lee: FYI retention: infra retains adminActivity logs 365d in GCS, but dataAccess/KMS operational logs are forwarded to security-logs for 90d. @Oncall can confirm exact policy.

Oncall: Confirmed — adminActivity exported 365d to the main bucket/BigQuery; dataAccess (including crypto operations) is 90d. We can rehydrate adminActivity >90d from GCS if needed.

Maria: Action items:
- Samir: export 90d audit logs filtered for svc-analytics-prod, KMS key accesses, and IAM binding changes; include query + raw JSON evidence. (due EOD)
- Dave: enumerate groups granting owner to this SA and propose least-privilege roles. (due +48h)
- Alex: draft a rollback/mitigation plan for the analytics job (feature flag, rotate creds, denylist). (due +24h)
- Lee: provide retention proof and restore steps for >90d if necessary. (due +48h)

Samir: running this filter now:
```
resource.type="service_account"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="svc-analytics-prod@redwood.com"
protoPayload.methodName:("SetIamPolicy" OR "GrantRole" OR "Decrypt" OR "Encrypt")
timestamp>="2025-12-01T00:00:00Z"
```
Will attach results to INC-2026-482.

security-bot: ticket INC-2026-482 created by Maria for svc-analytics-prod entitlement review. Priority: P2. Attach evidence to the ticket.

Maria: If we remove owner and it breaks, how quickly can we re-grant? Need a safe, auditable rollback path.

Dave: We can use short-lived grants: automation to add an IAM binding with an expiration condition or grant temporary group membership via our identity manager. Prefer automation for auditability.

Alex: Another safer path: spin up a scoped service account for the job with minimal roles, update the job to use it, rotate creds, then decommission svc-analytics-prod.

Lee: Note KMS nuance: cryptoKey-level IAM often lacks robust condition support; best to remove broad project-level owner bindings and then scope key permissions explicitly.

Maria: Keep updates in INC-2026-482. If we justify keeping owner for any reason, prepare an attestation doc with business justification and expiry. If not, schedule entitlement prune during next maintenance window.

Samir: Uploaded filtered logs + raw JSON to INC-2026-482; includes SetIamPolicy + KMS Decrypt entries. Link posted in ticket.

Dave: I posted a proposed minimal role set and a creds rotation plan in the ticket.

Maria: Thanks all. I'll run the attestation template once proposals land. Ping here if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
